parent_objective: design a fresh measured-validation protocol under the hard/soft offtrack metric
blocked_by: fresh measured validation must be designed before actual success can be claimed under the hard/soft metric
counterfactual relabeling is not actual success
metric-selected validation must preserve obstacle-risk and hard-failure reporting

public_gates: M2440 must design a metric-selected measured-validation protocol
M2440 must preserve actual success as an executed rollout outcome
M2440 must specify threshold policy, source scenarios, checkpoint set, hard failure, soft violation, and guardrail reporting
M2440 must not run measured rollout, repair, train, rank candidates/controllers, select winners, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run new measured rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the fresh measured-validation protocol required after hard/soft metric split audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: protocol design only; no new measured rollout, actual success claim, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if design treats old-row soft success as actual success
stop if design omits obstacle-risk or hard-failure guardrails
stop if design ranks candidates or controllers
stop if design claims scenario redesign was executed
fallback_plan: route to measured-validation implementation if protocol is complete
route to threshold policy audit if threshold selection is under-specified
route to task-boundary contract revision if hard/soft semantics are ambiguous
stop for user review if no bounded validation route is supported

admission_evidence: M2439 accepts M2438 metric split implementation
allowed_updates: M2440 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: source scenarios and checkpoint set are specified
actual success semantics under the selected metric are specified
hard failure soft violation and guardrail reporting are specified
a bounded implementation route is registered or the route is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2440 designs validation metrics and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2440; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2439 result audit and M2438 metric split panel.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the protocol cannot preserve the actual-success boundary, stop before measured validation.
allowed_claims: no actual success improvement, controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: sets up fresh measured validation under the metric split instead of another same-data relabel
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can enable actual measured validation under selected task metrics; cannot itself establish current-sim or paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: design cannot choose implementation or stop
another same-data relabel panel is proposed
counterfactual soft success would leak into actual success

hypothesis: A metric-selected measured-validation design will define how to obtain executed rollout evidence under the hard/soft offtrack metric without conflating old-row soft success with actual success.
success_criteria: threshold policy source scenarios checkpoint set hard failure soft violation and guardrail reporting are specified
actual success remains an executed rollout outcome only
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected
no rollout repair training ranking actual-success or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2440 ranks candidate families or controllers
M2440 treats old soft success as actual success
M2440 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID verdict claims
decision_rule: M2440 passes if it designs a bounded non-ranking metric-selected measured-validation protocol and route without rollout, repair, training, ranking, actual-success, or verdict claims.
